summary.text: Cathy Summers is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 94, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Republican Maryellen Murphy is also on the ballot.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is running to increase funding for school programs and supports raising the minimum wage and lowering taxes.

paragraphs.text: Cathy Summers advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary for District 94.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she believes in the power of family values, community involvement, and nurturing dreams.

She listed her key messages as fair pay and taxation, accessible healthcare for every person, and funding for education, including free or affordable trade schools, junior colleges and four-year degrees.
